topic: State the number of chromosomes in a normal human somatic cell
core_question: How many chromosomes are in a normal human somatic (body) cell? (secondary: What is the largest internal organ in the human body?)
answer_summary: 46 chromosomes (23 pairs) in a normal human diploid somatic cell.; after the topic shift: Answer must be liver, the largest internal organ.
